note: The original describes only the male alate.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Distinguished from all closely related species by the markedly round fontanelle within an orange-rimmed depression; other characters close to A. hondurensis.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Male: head chestnut-brown, wider than long (to the base of the postclypeus), densely hairy. Fontanelle a transparent, round, markedly raised spot in an orange-rimmed depression on the vertex, slightly smaller than an ocellus. Antennae yellow, 15 segments, densely covered with long hairs, progressively longer and wider towards the apex; segment 3 shorter than segments 2 and 4; segment 4 shorter than 2; apical segment slender, subelliptical. Compound eyes black, nearly round, protruding, adjacent to the lateral margins of the head. Ocelli transparent, suboval, upper margin projecting, their distance from the compound eyes equal to their long diameter. Postclypeus paler than the head (yellowish brown), projecting, bilobed, slightly more than twice as wide as long, densely covered with long hairs. Mandibles yellow with chestnut apices, elongate. Pronotum paler and narrower than the head, saddle-shaped, anterior margin straight, sides angularly sloping to the posterior margin (posterior margin straight), densely covered with long hairs. Posterior margins of meso- and metanotum concave. Wings grey, costal area golden brown, wing surface dotted, margins ciliate; media of forewing close to the cubitus and far from the subcosta, reaching the wing apex, simple or branched; cubitus not reaching the wing apex, with 10—11 branches or subbranches reaching the posterior margin, occupying less than half the wing width. Legs yellow with brown, with long hairs. Abdominal tergites chestnut, densely hairy; cerci indistinct. Measurements: alate male body length 11.50 mm; body length without wings 6.80 mm; head length (to the apex of the labrum) 1.20 mm; left mandible length 0.75 mm; pronotum length 0.65 mm, width 1.10 mm; hind tibia length 1.40 mm; forewing length 10.00 mm, width 2.60 mm; compound eye long diameter 0.27 mm; head width (between the eyes) 1.25 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality Rosario, Bolivia; described from two male alates collected in November 1921 (month 11) at the type locality together with workers; the same series included A. pacificus (alates and workers) and Capritermes (Neocapritermes) parallelus (soldiers and workers). Holotype male alate, USNM Cat. No. 27672.
